question: Notion task 区间1.618测试: can information available at the first weekly 1618 touch tell whether the level will hold (price returns to the Monday near edge before the 2.0 extension)?
motivation: Owner TradingView layout AlGc61US: 32 BTC + 8 XAU 1618 positions, all hindsight winners (31/31 BTC TP before SL). Used only to motivate features; see exp-monday-1618-owner-drawings-20261023-v1.
universe: OKX USDT swaps in data/kline_fetched with >=40000 15m bars, stablecoins excluded; data through 2026-08-14.
label: Valid = 15m bars reach Monday near edge before 2.0 extension; touch bar can only fail; same later bar both = fail; unresolved 14d = fail.
trade_view: Limit at 1618, SL 2.0 ext, TP Monday edge: +1.618R / -1R, breakeven validity 38.2 percent, fee 0.
selection: Univariate AUC screen on the earlier period only (|AUC-0.5|>=0.03), logistic regression C=0.5 on survivors, threshold = earlier-period 70th percentile score. Frozen before reading later-period results.
success_criterion: Later period: early-threshold selected touches validity >=38.2 percent AND mean R >0 AND week-stratified permutation p<0.01 for the top30 percent versus same-week touches AND later AUC>=0.55. Otherwise the task answer is that these causal features cannot judge validity.
null: Random-geometry controls: 3 random Tue-Sun 15m opens per touch, same symbol/week/side and R geometry, conservative stop-first. Stratified permutation controls week regime.
not_applicable: No top-decile net return model gate beyond the stated R view; AUC is diagnostic, not the success criterion alone.
limitations: 15m OHLC only, conservative intrabar ordering, independent R not account returns, no fees/funding/slippage. Altcoin universe may differ from BTC/XAU.
